title: AskUserQuestion Metadata — Tier 1 (Full)
description: Full 5-goal metadata for AskUserQuestion. All four top-level goal keys are expected. When presenting agent selection options, populate koth.agents_in_options to generate KOTH win/loss training signals from the user's choice. The experiment block is omitted for non-experimental calls.

notes.koth.agents_in_options: Set when options contain agent names. Selected agent = win, others = loss. Primary KOTH training signal (1.5x source weight).
notes.koth.question_type: Classify the decision type for KOTH domain routing.
notes.decision.signal_type: Typically 'pre_decision' — the question IS the decision point.
notes.experiment: Include when this AskUserQuestion call is part of a named A/B experiment (e.g., testing markdown-preview vs text-only option presentation).
